dict.string: Hourly Axelar XRPL Gateway SignerList rotation tracker. On first run, reads the current SignerList via account_objects and writes a bootstrap row (tx_hash='BOOTSTRAP') to bridge_signer_history. On each subsequent run, scans account_tx for the gateway in the (last_scanned_ledger, current_validated] range, filters TransactionType=='SignerListSet' with tesSUCCESS, and appends new rows. PK conflict on (ledger_index, tx_hash) makes overlapping re-runs idempotent. Steady-state windows at hourly cadence are ~1200 ledgers; MAX_LEDGERS_PER_RUN=2_500_000 caps post-outage resume. Writes a walker_health row keyed walker_name='bridge_signer_walker' on each non-dry-run pass. SignerListSet events fire weeks apart for the Axelar verifier set — most runs add 0 rows and just refresh the walker_health timestamp. Feeds the /sidechain verifier-set rotation history.
